commercial_hypothesis: Offline premium Windows. Target at least NOK 20,000 cash profit per game, before owner wage/personal tax. Only consider several games after actual results prove worthwhile. Price, production budget and sales unvalidated; no spending authorized.
evidence_limits: Desk research. No playable prototype, paid demand for this exact hook, measured production speed, or owner acceptance. Working label, not cleared final title.
title: Magnet Sweep — research label
hook: Sweep a magnet through a tray of scrap, separate two material types with a simple polarity change, and turn a small haul into a dramatic clearing sweep.
audience: Players buying short, satisfying active incrementals with visible growth and a finite ending.
core_loop: Sweep and collect; release into a furnace; buy a visibly different upgrade; clear the next bounded tray stage; finish a small visible restoration.

evidence.claim: 2025-08-16 Keep on Mining announcement reports over 100,000 copies and deliberate short-game scope. No development duration or net profit disclosed; not evidence for this specific magnet mechanic.
Nodebuster US list USD 2.99 in timestamped run snapshot; reviews are not sales. Adjacent active incremental positioning.

risks: Polarity could become busywork; its originality and fun are untested.
Realistic magnetism, piles and chains would break the small scope.
Pacing, art, saves, discovery and first-release setup may exceed five to eight intensive days.
Recent idle supply is crowded; one successful genre member does not predict our sales.
next_test: If selected, cap first experiment at one intensive day: one tray, two materials, two visibly distinct upgrades, real ten-minute play and a fifteen-second gameplay clip. Seek understandable collection and voluntary continuation; no new content to rescue a weak action. No implementation authorized yet.
decision_reason: First recommended experiment in the per-game income comparison, not a selected game. Fixed-view collection/progression differs from the held Scrap Swing transport loop.

scope_hypothesis.note: Unproven estimates, store lead time separate. Counts are ceilings: three material types, ten upgrades, three stages.
